thread:
Samir (platform): Heads-up — Sales just asked for a short burst bump for ClearWave during a live demo tomorrow morning. They want higher per-org throughput for ~2 hours. Can we do this without a full SLA change?

Jess (support): We can do a temporary policy, but need org-id + target rate + exact window. Also need billing note and abuse watch. Who's owning the rollback? :eyes: 

Lin (sales): Org: clearwave-prod (org_8b3f). Target: 5x their current spike limit, cap at 400 rps. Window: 2h starting 09:00 PDT tomorrow. Mateo — can eng make this on short notice? Demo is customer-facing.

Mateo (eng): Short answer: yes, but a few concerns: routing and per-key enforcement are surfaced at the token bucket layer — we can add a temporary override keyed by org-id. Need to ensure KV cache / batching doesn't let them exceed the 400 rps cap overall. Also prefer an automatic expiry + audit record.

Jess (support): I'll add billing tag and a support ticket with the rollback owner (that's me). We should also note this in the customer's account history.

Mateo (eng): Proposed config snippet (we can push via admin API):

```
PATCH /admin/ratelimits/policies
{
  "org_id": "org_8b3f",
  "override": {
    "type": "burst",
    "max_rps": 400,
    "burst_window_sec": 120,
    "expire_at": "2026-03-16T17:00:00Z",
    "audit_tag": "sales-demo-clearwave-20260316"
  }
}
```

Mateo (eng): Also suggest we add a hard token cap per API key: if they accidentally parallelize many keys, total org consumption still capped. Otherwise we risk cross-org head-of-line when routing is tight.

Lin (sales): Appreciate the config. We only have one key for the demo: partial key sk_live_9***abc. Please don't expose full key in logs.

Samir (platform): Good call on hard cap. Two action items: Mateo to create and deploy the override with auto-expiry + audit tag; Jess to file the support ticket & billing annotation; Lin will confirm demo start time. Ops/Telemetry should add a short alert rule to watch sustained >70% of the temporary cap.

Telemetry-bot: New metric watch created -> metric:ratelimit.org.org_8b3f. Alert: sustained >280 rps for 5m -> #eng-platform-alerts, severity:low.

OpsBot: Temporary policy created in staging and queued for prod push. ID: tmp-pol-20260316-57. Manual rollback endpoint: `POST /admin/ratelimits/rollback/tmp-pol-20260316-57`

Jess (support): Ticket #SUP-4321 created. Billing note added: "Demo rate elevation for ClearWave — temporary, 2h, capped, audit tag sales-demo-clearwave-20260316."

Mateo (eng): I'll run a quick smoke after deploy to validate enforcement under simulated concurrency (script: `scripts/stress_clearwave.sh`). If anything looks off we'll rollback early.

Lin (sales): Confirmed demo start 09:00 PDT. Thanks everyone — pls ping when it's live so I can give them the green light. :pray:

Samir (platform): Will post confirmation once prod push completes. Reminder: keep logs redacted for API keys and include the audit tag in the incident timeline.
